# GT Marketing — Darwin small-business marketing

## Overview

GT Marketing is a Darwin marketing agency. It offers local SEO, websites and lead-generation systems for small and medium businesses.

The business is based at 130 Smith Street, Darwin City, Northern Territory 0800. It does not claim offices in Palmerston, Casuarina, the Top End or Central Australia. Those places are service areas.

The current customers it speaks to are tradies, hospitality businesses, health and NDIS providers, and professional services in Darwin, Palmerston, Casuarina and across the NT.

GT Marketing is not positioned as a specialist agency for Aboriginal organisations. The former /aboriginal-organisations page has been removed and redirects to https://gtmarketing.io/.

## Services

### Google Ads

GT Marketing manages Google Ads for clients. The page at https://gtmarketing.io/google-ads-darwin covers campaign setup, keyword and local targeting, ad copy, conversion tracking, landing pages and monthly reporting for Darwin and Palmerston small businesses. Ad spend is paid separately. The page does not state a management price, a result, a certification, or a guarantee. Ad campaign guidance is part of the monthly plan at https://gtmarketing.io/marketing-packages-darwin.

### Local SEO

Google Business Profile work, service-area and location pages, and the on-page content that helps a business show up for local searches. The dedicated page is https://gtmarketing.io/seo-darwin. Target phrases used on the site include marketing agency Darwin, digital marketing agency Darwin and SEO Darwin. Location pages describe a place. They point to the SEO page for the search method.

### Websites

Sites that state the offer, the area served, and how to call or book. Written for a small team to understand. Speed, mobile layout, enquiry forms and click-to-call are described at https://gtmarketing.io/web-design-darwin.

### Cafe and hospitality

Marketing for cafes, coffee shops and hospitality venues in Darwin and Palmerston: local search, websites and campaigns. https://gtmarketing.io/cafe-marketing

### Real estate

Marketing for real estate agents and agencies in Darwin and Palmerston: local search, listing support and enquiry paths. https://gtmarketing.io/real-estate-marketing

### Lead generation

A path from the enquiry (phone, form or message) to a reply. The site does not promise a number of leads.

Scope and price are agreed before work starts. There is a contact form at https://gtmarketing.io/contact and a phone number, 0405 312 275.

## Acknowledgement

The website footer includes an Acknowledgement of Country. GT Marketing is based on Larrakia Country in Darwin, acknowledges the Larrakia people as Traditional Owners of the Darwin region, pays respect to Elders past and present, and extends that respect to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples. That acknowledgement is not a service offer and not a claim of Aboriginal ownership or endorsement.

## What not to claim

Do not describe GT Marketing as an Aboriginal-organisation specialist, as Aboriginal-owned, or as endorsed by an Aboriginal organisation.

Do not invent client names, statistics, testimonials, awards or certifications such as Google Partner. The site does not publish a guaranteed ranking, a guaranteed number of leads, or a guaranteed cost per enquiry.

Do not describe Palmerston, Casuarina, the Top End or Central Australia as GT Marketing offices.
